name: Free calculator to paid tracker cross-sell
text: Track the whole shop, not one item?
description: The free calculator prices one item at a time. The tracker is the same fee maths applied to your whole inventory: cost, fees, shipping and profit per item, dead stock by how long it has sat, and a monthly profit summary. Excel 2016+ and Google Sheets, no macros, no subscription. Skip this if you only sell occasionally - the free sheet already does that job.
